decision_summary.title: The Summoning Incident
decision_summary.review: Root reviewed all candidate terms, places, identities and reveal order; exact Satoko kana and special collections wording checked in the native source. Satoko and Tomie wiki sections rechecked.
decision_summary.nickname: No-Name is neutral until the source establishes sex; it is a temporary nickname, not an official birth name.
decision_summary.sensitive_context: Source3662–3663 is non-graphic objectifying commentary. Translate at that level only, without added explicit sexual description.
decision_summary.graphics: LIME phone messages, read counts, kana-board answers and typing jokes require coordinated prose/art adaptation before native integration.

entries.reading_status: explicit native kana and matching game-specific wiki
entries.role: Former first-year student at the protagonist’s school; Occult Club member; grandmother was a spirit medium.
entries.voice: Helpful and modest, initially concise board messages; gentle but firm after recovering her memory. The hostile half is a separate expression with murderous resentment; the external evil will is not simply another personal name.
entries.usage: Native1464 explicitly gives the full kana; comment1459 independently agrees. Five years before the present she was a first-year student and Occult Club member, who died on October20. Current anonymous helper and hostile spirit later prove to be split parts of her. Reveal those facts in source order; do not pre-name the helper or flatten the two parts into a single active speaker.

Helper denies first death-memory is her own and states a connection. She does not confirm Sakagami’s killed-by-spirit hypothesis at1195, yet his later message1269 reports it as apparently true. Preserve narrator’s provisional/conflicting reconstruction.
Campus cat Boss is physically present and carries amulet; Tomie is Reiko’s recorded ringtone, not the same animal.
Helper tentatively agrees to recognition/Occult Club hypothesis; do not pre-confirm a separate killed girl.
Photo identifies helper as Satoko. Both helpful and hostile halves derive from her; details depend on survivors.

First replay presents malicious fragments; all-survival replay reveals concern, ambulance called and attempted encouragement. External interference distorted hearing. Preserve both firsthand versions and their later explanation, not an editorial repair of early scene.
Messages labeled Makoto Shindo are actually Reiko using his phone; narrator explains this after first message. Preserve label, feminine/casual voice and timing of clarification.
Grandmother’s final appearance and vanishing evil shape include narrator inferences; do not add a new named entity or a demon identity.
